title: Physics-informed neural networks for strain-dependent bandgaps in diamond
description:
Code and data for predicting the bandgap of strained diamond from the six-component Green-Lagrange strain tensor. A neural network is combined with deformation-potential and Bir-Pikus models of how strain shifts the band edges.

Includes the dataset of 1,292 deformation states computed with hybrid-functional DFT, the VASP inputs and relaxed structures, the analytic models and their calibration, the training program, the task list of every training run of the paper, the baselines, summaries of all runs, and the analysis that produces every number, table and figure of the paper.
